title: Keep the database private
summary: The notes app works, but web can reach the database directly. Split it into two networks so only api can.

tasks.title: Two networks exist: `front-net` and `back-net`
tasks.hint: `docker network create front-net` and `docker network create back-net`.

tasks.title: `api` is on both networks
tasks.hint: api talks to web and to db, so it needs a cable to each: `docker network connect front-net api` and `docker network connect back-net api`.

tasks.title: `web` and `db` share no network at all
tasks.hint: Put web on `front-net` and db on `back-net`. Then unplug both from `notes-all`: `docker network disconnect notes-all web` (and the same for db and api).

tasks.title: `http://localhost:3301` still works, with no red error
tasks.hint: If web can't reach api, they don't share `front-net`. If api can't reach the database, api and db don't share `back-net`.
